description: A Flutter widget called SwipeDeck that displays a stack of cards and provides like/dislike buttons to navigate through them. It manages user interactions and card state internally.

classes.name: SwipeDeck
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a series of cards with swipe interaction capabilities. It initializes with a list of widget cards and a callback for swipe actions.

classes.name: _SwipeDeckState
classes.description: State class for SwipeDeck that manages the current index and user interaction logic.

methods.name: SwipeDeck
methods.description: Constructor for the SwipeDeck widget that requires a list of cards and a callback function to handle swipe events.

methods.name: _advance
methods.description: Internal method to invoke the onSwipe callback and move to the next card.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the SwipeDeck, showing the current card or a message when no more cards are available.
